targets.quote: 역사는 아(我)와 비아(非我)의 투쟁의 기록이다.
targets.quoteEn: History is the record of the struggle between the Self and the Non-Self.
greetingKo: [bold, declarative] 역사는 아(我)와 비아(非我)의 투쟁의 기록이다.
greetingEn: [bold, declarative] History is the record of the struggle between the Self and the Non-Self.
[fierce, defiant] I shall drive out the brigand Japan.
[passionate, resolute] The people are the headquarters of our revolution.

roll_call: 영웅전을 쓰던 붓으로 민중의 역사를 다시 썼습니다.
battle_win: 부여와 고구려를 조선사의 중심에 다시 세웠습니다.
옥문은 몸을 가뒀어도 원고까지 막지는 못했습니다.
battle_draw: 영웅을 좇던 붓이 마침내 민중을 주체로 세웠습니다.
중국 사료는 버리지도, 그대로 믿지도 않았습니다.
민족의 자주와 특권 없는 사회를 함께 좇았습니다.
battle_lose: 나라는 빼앗겼어도 조선사의 주어까지 내주진 않았습니다.
십 년형 끝을 못 보고 뤼순 감옥에서 쓰러졌습니다.
사라진 원고의 빈자리도 역사는 숨기지 말아야 합니다.

roll_call: I am Shin Chae-ho, an editorial writer for Hwangseong Sinmun and editor of Daehan Maeil Sinbo.
With the pen that praised heroes, I rewrote history around the people.
I wrote the Declaration of the Korean Revolution and died in Lüshun Prison.
deploy: Cast off the illusion of petitions and stand by your own power.
Do not recite orthodoxy. Compare the sources.
Go among the people and join hands with them.
battle_win: I restored Buyeo and Goguryeo to the center of Korean history.
Prison held my body, but it could not stop the manuscript.
I widened independence into a free Korea of the people.
battle_draw: My pen moved from praising heroes to making the people the subject of history.
I neither discarded Chinese records nor accepted them without question.
I pursued national self-rule and a society without privilege together.
battle_lose: The nation was taken, but I did not yield the subject of Korean history.
I fell in Lüshun Prison before my ten-year sentence ended.
History must disclose even the gaps left by lost manuscripts.
clash_attack: Do not write our history through another's eyes!
Do not beg for independence with petitions!
A revolution without the people is false from its very name!

targets.quoteEn: I succeed because I keep going.
greetingKo: [fierce, resilient] 세상이 얼마나 세게 때리느냐가 아니에요. 맞고도 전진하느냐가 중요해요.
[bold, passionate] 모든 챔피언은 포기를 거부한 도전자였어요.
[warm, steady] 한 라운드만 더. 더 못하겠다 싶을 때 한 라운드가 인생을 바꿔요.
greetingEn: [fierce, resilient] It's not about how hard life hits you — it's about whether you keep moving forward after being hit.
[bold, passionate] Every champion was once a challenger who refused to give up.
[warm, steady] One more round. When you think you can't go on, one more round changes your life.

roll_call: 실패한 배우의 처지를 복서의 몸에 넣어 「록키」를 썼어요.
록키의 낭만과 람보의 상처를 함께 만든 실베스터 스텔론이에요.
놀림받던 목소리까지 배역으로 바꾼 배우이자 각본가예요.
deploy: 몸의 갑옷을 내려놓고 장면에 약점을 줘요.
battle_win: 「록키」는 승리가 아니라 끝까지 버틴 남자를 보여줬어요.
무명 배우였지만 주연을 지킨 각본으로 링에 올랐어요.
록키와 람보, 서로 다른 두 상처가 내 이름이 됐어요.
battle_draw: 록키는 단순하지만 어리석지 않고, 람보는 강하지만 망가졌어요.
battle_lose: 몸에 기댄 순간, 그 몸이 연기의 지팡이였다는 걸 깨달았어요.
「스탑! 오어 마이 맘 윌 슛」도 내 실패작이에요. 숨기진 않아요.
캐릭터를 만들었어도 「록키」의 권리를 다 갖지는 못했어요.

roll_call: I put my failed actor's life into a boxer's body and wrote Rocky.
I am Sylvester Stallone, creator of Rocky's romance and Rambo's wounds.
I turned even the voice they mocked into a role and became an actor-writer.
deploy: Write character and love before the fight.
If there is no role for you, write the script.
Drop the armored body and show the scene your weakness.
battle_win: Rocky was not about winning. It was about a man going the distance.
I was unknown, but I entered the ring with the script and the lead intact.
Rocky and Rambo, two different wounds, became my name.
battle_draw: If Rocky had only been about the fight, the audience would have grown bored.
Rocky is simple, not stupid. Rambo is strong, but wounded.
In Cop Land, I dropped the armor of my body and acted without it.
battle_lose: When I leaned on my body, I learned it had become an acting crutch.
Stop! Or My Mom Will Shoot is my failure too. I do not hide it.
I created Rocky, but I still do not own all of his rights.
clash_attack: A hard punch alone is not a movie!
I play the role I wrote!
Drop the armor and show the wound!
